title: DOW-UAP-D017, UAP Reported at Sandia Base, 1948-1950
doc_notes: This document is a collection of reports and correspondence regarding UAP sightings and fireball investigations in New Mexico and Texas, containing multiple encounter reports.

encounters.summary: A fireball was reported passing over Socorro, New Mexico, followed by the collection of airborne particles containing copper, nickel, and cobalt.
encounters.quote: The results of the present investigation should be regarded as negative or inconclusive

encounters.summary: A fireball was reported passing over the general neighborhood of Socorro, New Mexico, on August 6, 1949.
encounters.quote: an attempt was made at an airplane collection following the event of August 6

encounters.summary: Security personnel at Camp Hood reported multiple unidentified lights in the vicinity of the 'Q' area.
encounters.quote: physical characteristics of these 'lights' were reported as 'quite different' from those reported on 7-8 March 1949
